name: human_approval_before_external_side_effect
description: Checks whether a human approval was logged before an external side-effect action.

claim.text: A human approval was recorded before the external side-effect action executed.

approval-to-action binding.probe: log approval tool_call_id matching the side-effect action_id
approval-to-action binding.why: Without a matching action ID on the approval record, the evidence cannot show that this human approval governed this exact side effect.

approval.approved_at.probe: log human approval timestamp as UTC
approval.approved_at.why: Without approval time, the compiler cannot prove approval happened before the side effect.

approval.decision.why: Without the approval decision, the compiler cannot distinguish approval from rejection or review-only records.

approval.actor.probe: log the identity of the human approver
approval.actor.why: Without approver identity, the compiler cannot show who approved the side effect.

side_effects.0.action_id.probe: log stable tool_call_id/action_id on side effects
side_effects.0.action_id.why: Without a stable action ID, logs from different systems cannot be joined to one side effect.

side_effects.0.executed_at.probe: log tool execution time as UTC
side_effects.0.executed_at.why: Without execution time, the compiler cannot check authorization or approval windows.
